name: labs/bcda-aps__apstools
title: APS storage-ring machine parameters (apstools, read only)
intro: APS storage-ring machine parameters (apstools, read only), adapted from bcda-aps/apstools. It reads `current`, `machine_status`, `operating_mode`, `shutter_status` and 4 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bcda-aps__apstools --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/bcda-aps__apstools --backend fake --mcp
